bambuddy.key.step3: Set the key exactly like this:

keyright.name: Name
bambuddy.user.title: Create a group and a user in Bambuddy
bambuddy.user.why: Reprintbuddy needs its own group in Bambuddy, because none of the system groups fits: "Operators" only sees its own files and queue entries, and "Administrators" may do everything.
bambuddy.user.group: In Bambuddy open Settings → Users and create a group named "Reprintbuddy" with exactly these rights (the internal name is in brackets):
bambuddy.user.user: Then create the user "reprintbuddy" and put it in this group.
bambuddy.user.password: The password of this user is needed only once, to create the key in the next step. Reprintbuddy neither asks for it nor stores it.
bambuddy.key.title: Create the API key
bambuddy.key.intro: A key always belongs to the user who is signed in when it is created. So do this as the new user:
bambuddy.key.step1: Sign out of Bambuddy and sign in as "reprintbuddy".
bambuddy.key.step2: Open Settings → API keys → Create key.
bambuddy.key.step4: Copy the key at once. Bambuddy shows it only one time.
bambuddy.connect.title: Enter the address and the key
bambuddy.connect.intro: Reprintbuddy asks Bambuddy whom the key belongs to and what it may really do. The key is saved only if it has every right Reprintbuddy needs.
bambuddy.result.fix: Set the missing rights for the group "Reprintbuddy" in Bambuddy (Settings → Users) and check again.
bambuddy.admin_warning: Saved. The key belongs to an administrator and may do more than Reprintbuddy needs. It is safer to use the user "reprintbuddy" from the guide.

settings.title: Settings
settings.bambuddy_hint: Changes are saved only if the connection check succeeds.
settings.secret_stored: A value is stored. Leave the field empty to keep it; enter a new value to replace it.
settings.restart_needed: Changes to address, port and HTTPS take effect after Reprintbuddy has been restarted.
settings.https_hint: Paste the certificate and private key as text or upload the files. Leave both empty to keep what is stored.
settings.tls_none: No certificate stored: Reprintbuddy serves plain HTTP.
settings.tls_remove: Remove certificate and private key (serve plain HTTP)
settings.invalid_port: The port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
settings.invalid_pem: The certificate or the private key could not be read. Expected PEM text, at most 64 KB.
settings.key_required_new_address: The address has changed. Please enter the API key again: a stored key is never sent to a new address.
settings.host_unbindable: This machine cannot listen on this address. Check it: saving an unusable address would lock you out.
bambuddy.key_invalid: The API key contains characters that are not allowed (only visible ASCII characters, no spaces or line breaks). Please copy it again.

settings.privileged_port: Saved. Note: ports below 1024 need the right to bind privileged ports. Changes take effect after Reprintbuddy has been restarted; if it does not start, set another port with the command set-port.
